name: virtual-art-gallery
description: A virtual art gallery with VR support, AI curation, and IoT integration

scripts.bootstrap: npm run setup && npm run setup:ai && npm run dev:all
scripts.//dev: Flags: --kill-others-on-fail false keeps Express up if Vite crashes; nodemon auto-restarts Express on file changes; tsx lets server.js require TypeScript route files directly
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false --names "server,vite" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "PORT=3001 nodemon --ignore src/frontend --ignore src/test --ignore node_modules --exec tsx server.js" "bash -c 'while true; do echo \"[vite] starting...\"; (cd src/frontend && npx vite --port 5000 --host); echo \"[vite] crashed or exited — restarting in 3s...\"; sleep 3; done'"
scripts.//dev:all: Starts Node.js server, Vite, and the Python AI/ML service together with labeled output. The AI service auto-restarts on crash via a shell retry loop.
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false --names "server,vite,ai" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "PORT=3001 nodemon --ignore src/frontend --ignore src/test --ignore node_modules --exec tsx server.js" "bash -c 'while true; do echo \"[vite] starting...\"; (cd src/frontend && npx vite --port 5000 --host); echo \"[vite] crashed or exited — restarting in 3s...\"; sleep 3; done'" "bash -c 'while true; do echo \"[ai] starting...\"; (cd ai-ml-service && python3 -m uvicorn src.models.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001); echo \"[ai] crashed or exited — restarting in 3s...\"; sleep 3; done'"
scripts.build: npx tailwindcss -i src/frontend/assets/css/tailwind-input.css -o src/frontend/assets/css/tailwind-output.css --minify && npx vite build --config vite.config.ts

author: Virtual Art Gallery Team
